description: This file implements the SharedFdChannel class, which manages communication over shared file descriptors, including sending and receiving messages, waiting for messages, and handling message I/O operations.

classes.name: SharedFdChannel
classes.description: A class that facilitates communication over shared file descriptors, providing methods to send requests/responses, receive messages, and wait for incoming messages.

methods.name: SharedFdChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the channel with input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message over the channel.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message over the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the input descriptor, parsing the message header and payload.

methods.name: WaitForMessage
methods.description: Waits for an incoming message to be available on the input descriptor.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over the output descriptor, marking it as a response if specified.
